note: Wooded family campground on a peninsula in the Castle Rock Flowage of the Wisconsin River, separate from the park's cart-in and backpack sites; a crushed-rock path runs from the campground toward the day-use area along the water. A 2026 road-construction project was to affect some sites and the boat launch (no notice on the DNR conditions page, 2026-11-17). --Claude
summary: DNR park, camping and conditions pages and the park map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 69 family sites (20 electric: 17 standard + 3 accessible), pull-throughs, shower/flush-toilet building, dump station. Pin on the campground's shower building. Not waterfront confirmed (nearest backwater ~150 m west through forest).
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. On Esri imagery the westmost family sites sit ~150 m or more from the Wisconsin River backwater channel through unbroken forest; the rest are further inland.
PIN: 43.9414,-90.0164 sits on the shower building in the middle of the family campground (OSM camp node 43.94075,-90.01685, ~75 m). Fine.
